title: Ravana Never Taught Lakshmana
source: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 6(97) (Critical Edition; vulgate 6.108)

captions.instagram:
Did the dying Ravana really teach Lakshmana?

Many of us have heard that the dying Ravana taught Lakshmana lessons in statecraft, and that Rama sent Lakshmana to learn from him. In Valmiki's Ramayana, the Brahmastra strikes Ravana's chest, pierces his heart, and he falls from his chariot already lifeless. There are no last words and no lesson. Lakshmana is busy with the victory, and soon crowns Vibhishana king of Lanka. The story of Ravana's last lesson came later.

Where did you first hear the story of Ravana's last lesson to Lakshmana? Next: how Ravana actually died, and the navel arrow 👇

Did the dying Ravana really teach Lakshmana?

Many of us have heard that the dying Ravana taught Lakshmana lessons in statecraft, and that Rama sent Lakshmana to learn from him. In Valmiki's Ramayana, the Brahmastra strikes Ravana's chest, pierces his heart, and he falls from his chariot already lifeless. There are no last words and no lesson. Lakshmana is busy with the victory, and soon crowns Vibhishana king of Lanka. The story of Ravana's last lesson came later.

Where did you first hear the story of Ravana's last lesson to Lakshmana? Next: how Ravana actually died, and the navel arrow 👇

Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 6(97) (Critical Edition; vulgate 6.108)
Verses:
• Matali urges Rama to release the Brahmastra for Ravana's destruction — 6.97.1-2
• The weapon had been given to Rama by the sage Agastya — 6.97.4
• The arrow fell upon Ravana's chest and pierced his heart — 6.97.16-17
• His bow fell, his life-breaths departed; he fell from the chariot to the ground, lifeless — 6.97.20-21
• Lakshmana joins Sugriva, Vibhishana and others in honouring the victorious Rama — 6.97.32
• At Rama's command Lakshmana consecrates Vibhishana as king of Lanka — 6.100.11-12
• No words from Ravana after the arrow and no teaching of Lakshmana anywhere in the death and aftermath chapters (CE 6.97-6.100) — 6.97-6.100 (chapters, read)
• Opening śloka: “Lifeless, the mighty lord of the rakshasas fell from his chariot to the ground, like Vritra struck by the thunderbolt.” — 6.97.21
